explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with `next_token()`, checking only ordinary `#text` tokens via `get_token_type()` and `get_modifiable_text()`. Matching text nodes are emitted as `<mark>` plus `serialize_token()` so the result stays normalized while preserving the processor’s HTML serialization rules.
